newsitem.title: FRANCE: Worms&Cie sees 96 net/shr equal 95 or more.
newsitem.headline: Worms&Cie sees 96 net/shr equal 95 or more.

text.p: France's Worms & Cie said after reporting a first-half profit rise on Thursday that it expected net profit per share for the whole of 1996 to at least match that of 1995.
It said in a statement its result for the first half, including a net attributable profit of 16.78 francs for share, could not be extrapolated to estimate full-year results.

"Nevertheless, barring any specific elements, the result per share for 1996 should be at least equivalent to that of last year." Its net attributable profit per share in the first half was 16.78 francs.
